🥣 Ingredients

For the filling:
🔺 200 g walnuts (lightly toasted and finely chopped)
🔺 100 g sugar
🔺 2 egg whites
🔺 2–3 tbsp jam (apricot works great)

For the dough:
🔺 150 g butter, melted and cooled
🔺 100 g powdered sugar
🔺 1 egg yolk
🔺 8 g vanilla sugar (or 1 tsp vanilla extract)
🔺 100 g sour cream or plain yogurt (room temperature)
🔺 350–380 g all-purpose flour
🔺 10 g baking powder
🔺 Pinch of salt (this was missing — but trust me, it matters 😉)

👩‍🍳 Instructions

1️⃣ Prepare the filling:
Toast the walnuts lightly in a dry pan or oven, then chop them finely. Mix with sugar, egg whites, and jam until well combined.

2️⃣ Make the dough:
In a bowl, mix melted butter, powdered sugar, egg yolk, vanilla sugar, and sour cream until smooth.

3️⃣ Gradually add flour mixed with baking powder and a pinch of salt. Mix until you get a soft, slightly non-sticky dough.

4️⃣ Cover the dough and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

5️⃣ Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).
